description:
Pause a tenant.

Stops all sending for the tenant. Sends return `403 sending_paused`; emails already queued fail. The body is optional.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `POST /tenants/{ref}/pause` (operationId `pauseTenant`, Tenants).

reason.description: Stored as `paused_reason`. Defaults to a generic reason.

ref.description: The tenant id or your own `external_id`.

name: pause_tenant
title: Pause a tenant
